study: E1b confirmatory: do weights-only adapter-overlap predictors predict task-arithmetic merge loss?

substitutions.trec: none: CogComp/trec main branch has an unsupported loading script; the same repo's Hub-generated parquet branch refs/convert/parquet (commit 65752bf53af25bc935a0dce92fb5b6c930728450) is used. Same dataset, same splits; not a substitute.

recipe.scheduler: linear with warmup; warmup_steps = min(500, round(0.1*max_steps))
recipe.segment_ids: standard BERT token_type_ids (tokenizer output) in BOTH training and evaluation

splits.holdout: rng=np.random.default_rng(0); perm=rng.permutation(n_train); hold=perm[:1000] (never trained on; lambda selection only); pool=perm[1000:]; train=pool[:60000] if len(pool)>60000 else pool

integrity.a_majority: metric >= majority-class baseline + 0.10 (majority label = most frequent label in the task's training set used; baseline = its accuracy on the eval set used; ties -> the tied label with the higher eval accuracy); stsb: Spearman >= 0.70

b_glue_reference.source: HuggingFace transformers examples/pytorch/text-classification/README.md, run_glue.py dev-set results for bert-base-cased (FP32 column), seq len 128, bs 32, lr 2e-5, 3 epochs (MRPC 5)
b_glue_reference.rule: ours >= reference - 0.05 on the listed metric (CoLA: MCC, because no accuracy is published)

integrity.c_logit_equivalence: max |logit(manual merge W0+dW + own head) - logit(PeftModel)| <= 1e-4 on the first 64 eval examples, fp32, TF32 disabled
integrity.exclusion: a task failing any applicable criterion is excluded with all its pairs BEFORE predictors/merges; if < 12 valid tasks remain: STOP and report

predictors.O_A: mean over layers of mean_k cos^2(theta_k), theta = principal angles between orth(B1) and orth(B2) (QR, float64)
predictors.tv_cosine: cosine of flattened concatenated dW = (alpha/r) B@A over all LoRA layers
secondary: O_B (top-r left singular vectors of B@A)
TIES sign conflict (top-20% |dW| per task, global; fraction of jointly kept coords with opposite signs)
null z-score of O_A vs 1000 random rank-8 subspace pairs (seed 0)
predictors.freeze: predictors.csv + predictors.sha256 written before any merge; merges refuse to run if the hash changes

merge.method: task arithmetic W0 + lam*(dW1+dW2) on all LoRA layers; each task evaluated with its own classifier head
merge.lambda_selection: per pair, maximize mean normalized score on the two 1000-example held-out TRAIN sets; ties -> smaller lam
merge.normalized_score: merged metric / single-adapter metric on the same eval set (accuracy; stsb Spearman)
merge.D: 1 - mean of the two normalized eval-set scores at the selected lam
merge.pair_order: t1 precedes t2 in the task list order

analysis.permutation: 10000 random relabelings of tasks applied to the D matrix (predictor fixed), np.random.default_rng(0); one-sided p=(1+#{rho_perm>=rho_obs})/(1+10000)
analysis.multiplicity: Holm over {H1,H2} on the one-sided permutation p
analysis.bootstrap: task-block: 2000 reps, resample K tasks with replacement (np.random.default_rng(0), separate generator), use all pairs of distinct resampled indices, percentile 95% CI
analysis.loto: leave-one-task-out rho for each valid task
analysis.PASS: rho >= 0.4 AND Holm-adjusted one-sided permutation p < 0.05 AND >= 75% of LOTO rho > 0.2
analysis.FAIL: (if not PASS) task-block bootstrap 95% upper bound < 0.3 (meaningful effect ruled out)

exploratory: secondary predictors (rho, bootstrap CI, permutation p; not used for verdicts)
rho(predictor, D_lam) for each fixed lam in the grid (eval set evaluated at all 4 lam)

method comparison per pair: TA at selected lam; TIES-lite (trim top-20% per task globally, sign election by sum, disjoint mean, merged = W0 + lam*tau) at the TA-selected lam and at its own held-out-selected lam; theta*=30deg hard gate (per layer, shared directions S = principal vectors of orth(B1) with theta<30deg vs orth(B2); on such FAIL layers dW2 <- (I - S S^T) dW2; merged = W0 + lam*(dW1+dW2')) at the TA-selected lam and at its own held-out-selected lam. Summary: mean normalized score, win/tie/loss vs TA, paired Wilcoxon (exploratory).
known_properties: All adapters use seed 0: LoRA A matrices start from identical initializations across tasks (B starts at 0); classifier init differs only by shape. Any shared-init overlap is part of the measured predictor.
O_B spans the same space as O_A when A has full row rank (expected O_B == O_A up to numerics).
The null z-score is a linear transform of O_A (identical layer shapes for all pairs) -> same rho.
